_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

segments.text: Boat, Vote, Ban, Van. Watch my mouth.
Repeat after me. Boat, Vote, Ban, Van.

native.hook: B o V: ¡mira bien mis labios!
native.caption: En español la b y la v suenan igual, pero en inglés no. En “vote” y “van” los dientes tocan el labio; en “boat” y “ban” se cierran los labios. Mira la boca de Carlos y repite en la pausa. Práctica en la app Lexkite.

en.hook: B or V: watch my lips!
en.caption: In Spanish b and v sound the same, but not in English. In “vote” and “van” your teeth touch your lip; in “boat” and “ban” your lips close. Watch Carlos’s mouth and repeat in the pause. Practice in the Lexkite app.
